blocks.text: よーし、私も戦っちゃうぞ!
blocks.translation: Alright, I'm going to fight too!

blocks.text: 完成、グレイトフルフェニックス!

OK牧場、充瑠くん!懲りないガルザにはこってりコテコテのお仕置きだ!
ブー!先日はガルザに拘束されるという我が輩の失態をお許しくださり、まことに恐縮です!
王は本当に幼い頃から、お優しく・・・・・
blocks.translation:
You got it, Juru-kun! We're going to give that incorrigible Garza a real, heavy-duty thrashing!
*Snort!* I am truly humbled that you forgave my blunder of letting Garza capture me the other day!
Your Majesty has been so kind ever since you were just a small child...

blocks.text: 呼ばれて飛び出てザザザビューン!
blocks.translation: You called, so here I come—whoosh!

blocks.text: 呼ばれてないが俺様も行く!
blocks.translation: I wasn't called, but I'll go too!

blocks.text: あのミンジョとかいう奴、あいつはヌマージョの妹なんだ。 俺にやらせてくれっ!
blocks.translation: That Minjo or whatever—she's Numajo's little sister. Let me do it!

blocks.text: へっ!いい夢見ろよ羊野郎!
